presentation.label: SCALE / ROOT
presentation.summary: Keep audio and MIDI tracks in one of 24 scales with a selectable root, and take single tracks out of it.
presentation.overview: Scale Quantizer adds SCALE, ROOT, GLIDE, TRACK and FOLLOW to PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER. Pitch turns, parameter locks and chromatic trig keys move through scale degrees, and what audio and MIDI tracks play follows the scale, so recorded notes follow a scale change. ROOT transposes the scale and keyboard. TRACK picks an audio or MIDI track and FOLLOW OFF keeps that track stock; SCALE OFF restores stock pitch behavior.
highlights: 24 scales plus OFF, selectable root C–B
Recorded notes follow a scale change on audio and MIDI tracks
TRACK and FOLLOW take single audio or MIDI tracks out of the scale
usage: Open PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER and set SCALE. OFF preserves stock pitch behavior; choose a scale to constrain notes.
Set ROOT to the key you want. Pitch edits step by scale degree; chromatic keys snap to a degree and key 1 plays the root. Notes already recorded play in the new scale.

Set TRACK to a track (AUDIO 1..8, MIDI 1..8) and FOLLOW to OFF for a track that should stay chromatic (drums, samples with fixed pitch). TRACK only chooses what FOLLOW shows and is not saved; it starts at AUDIO 1.
SCALE, ROOT, GLIDE and the track switches are saved with the project and kept in battery RAM. Synth polyphony and synth glide features require FM Synth, which carries its own copy of this quantizer.

controls.name: SCALE
controls.doc: OFF restores stock pitch behavior; select a scale to constrain PTCH edits, locks and chromatic keys.

controls.name: ROOT
controls.doc: Root of the scale and chromatic keyboard. Ignored with SCALE OFF.

controls.name: GLIDE
controls.doc: OFF or 1–127 slide time; the track LEG setting controls legato. Synth features require the separate SYNTH MACHINE module.

controls.name: TRACK
controls.doc: Picks the track FOLLOW shows: AUDIO 1..8, then MIDI 1..8. Changes no sound; not saved (AUDIO 1 at power-on).

controls.name: FOLLOW
controls.doc: The switch of the track TRACK shows: ON (default) follows SCALE and ROOT; OFF keeps that track stock in every path. Saved per track with the project.

limitations: Sample pitch quantization works on Flex, Static and Pickup; RATE is not a semitone control.
SCALE, ROOT and GLIDE are shared project settings; TRACK and FOLLOW switch single tracks off.
The module adds five SEQUENCER rows (SCALE, ROOT, GLIDE, TRACK, FOLLOW), within the eight the Modwerk base gives over USB; card builds show the same five.

FM Synth carries its own copy of this quantizer (the same source) and declares a conflict with this module: both would patch the same sites, and a module may not hook into another module's code, rows, tables or files (the owner, #555, 31 October 2026). Synth polyphony and synth-specific tuning and glide need FM Synth.

Reported working by the author on his MKI twice, on the same bytes: TEST2 on 30 October 2026 and TEST3 (the module rebuilt on current main, byte-identical) on 1 November 2026 (TESTING.md): the rows, FOLLOW acting at play, save and power-cycle; the optional 2.21-saved-project step not stated. Play time and readings were not recorded. Audio measurements, chip timing and complete memory bounds remain unmeasured.

storage.label: ROM footprint
storage.conditions: Card build of 0.1.4: a 204-byte core, the 45-byte key stub and the 6-byte scale trampoline in ROM. The DRAM quantizer unit (6,084 bytes of code and data in the USB package, with its glue), the grown menus and loader overhead are additional.

processing.label: CPU load
processing.conditions: No comparable hardware CPU utilization measurement is supplied.

impact.conditions: Audio modules are rated for an active instance, including expensive modes and changing controls; MIDI/USB features are rated while enabled. More tracks or instances increase demand. Shared runtime reservations and reused stock buffers are not added again per module. These rough source-backed tiers do not establish hardware headroom or qualification.

cpu.rationale: Scale Quantizer applies bounded note/pitch and control hooks on ColdFire. It adds no continuous audio-processing engine; low is a source estimate and dense note/control traffic can increase work.

dsp.rationale: The author documentation explicitly declares no DSP code for this module. Minimal rates added quantizer DSP demand; stock voice rendering remains part of the whole device load.

memory.rationale: The card build has a 255-byte ROM core/stub/trampoline footprint plus small settings. DRAM code, menus and loader overhead are additional. Minimal is a relative source estimate, not a claim that total memory is only 255 bytes.

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial: choose a scale
steps: Open PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER and scroll to SCALE. Turn LEVEL to select MAJOR; OFF restores stock pitch behavior.
Scroll to ROOT and turn LEVEL to choose C. ROOT transposes the selected scale and the audio chromatic keyboard.
Close the project menu, select a Flex or Static audio track with a sample assigned, and turn PTCH or play the chromatic trig keys. Notes follow the selected scale; recorded notes play in it too.
Back in SEQUENCER, set TRACK to AUDIO 1 (or MIDI 1) and FOLLOW to OFF: that track plays unquantized while the others follow the scale.

access.location: PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER: SCALE, ROOT, GLIDE, TRACK and FOLLOW rows.
steps: On the MKII panel, press PROJ to open the project menu.
Use UP/DOWN to select CONTROL, then press RIGHT to enter its list.
Select SEQUENCER with UP/DOWN and press YES.
Scroll DOWN to SCALE and turn LEVEL to choose a scale. OFF restores stock pitch behavior.
Scroll to ROOT and turn LEVEL to select the key. GLIDE is the next row; its effect depends on the track’s LEG setting. TRACK and FOLLOW follow (TRACK picks a track, FOLLOW is its ON / OFF).
